notes.maseeh-hall: Building W1, Fariborz Maseeh Hall, at its point on MIT's campus map (m.mit.edu/apis/maps/places, the list in config/mit.codes.json); OSM doesn't name it.
notes.east-campus: East Campus is buildings 62 and 64 (MIT campus map); pinned on OSM's MIT Building 62 (way/29650662).
notes.grad-tower-site4: OSM's E37 at 45 Hayward Street (way/1264845022); MIT Graduate Housing's own map puts the Graduate Tower at Site 4 16 m from its centre (gradhousing.mit.edu/communities/graduate-tower-at-site-4).
notes.westgate-apartments: Building W85, Westgate (Family Housing), at its point on MIT's campus map; OSM doesn't name it.
notes.w8-resch-boathouse: Rowing boathouse, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.w64-koch-childcare-center: Childcare centre, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.w53-carr-indoor-tennis: Indoor tennis courts, not a class building.
notes.boston-marriott-cambridge: A hotel (the MIT list joins NE18, 1 Cambridge Center, to it by name), not somewhere classes happen.
notes.w91: IS&T Operations building (data centre and offices), not somewhere classes happen.

detours.why: The Grand Junction railroad runs between Vassar Street and Albany Street; these halls and buildings are on opposite sides of it, so walks go round to the mapped crossings (at Massachusetts Avenue and the ends of the line).
Briggs Field and the athletic fields lie between the Memorial Drive halls and the Heinz Building with no mapped path across, so walks go round them.
No mapped path leads from Maseeh Hall straight to Kresge Oval; walks go out to Massachusetts Avenue and back in.
Kendall Square city blocks: buildings fill the blocks between E37 and these buildings with no mapped way through, so walks go round by the streets.
N52 is across Massachusetts Avenue from Random Hall; walks use the mapped crosswalk.
The Westgate buildings and lots lie between Tang Hall and WW25 with no mapped path through, so walks go round them.
